purpose: functional verification of Git repositories in environments on KVM; no timing claim

cases.name: an environment with a Git repository twice is described without credentials
a sandbox created with it has each tree, the right branch's files, owned by its user
what cannot be is refused before anything boots, and no sandbox is left

refused.credentials on a Git repository: a Git repository is cloned without credentials: give it neither username nor password
refused.a remote the operator did not allow: http://127.0.0.1:42199/elsewhere.git: this node clones Git repositories only from the remotes its operator allows
